topic.title: Juniper Optical Troubleshooting
topic.diagnosis: Low or unstable receive power can indicate fiber loss, dirty connectors, bad patching, excessive distance, wrong optic type, or remote transmitter problems.
topic.compareBothEnds: Collect optical diagnostics from both sides whenever possible.

actions.item: Clean fiber connectors according to approved procedure.
Replace suspect patch lead or optic.
Escalate with optical readings and timestamps.

topic.warning: Do not replace hardware solely from one abnormal reading without checking the complete optical path.
